dct_description_sm: The bird atlas survey (2006-2010)  can be viewed as a tool to monitor biodiversity. The main aim of the third atlas was to examine the present distribution of Finnish birds, and to investigate changes in distribution together with other environmental data. In particular, the first bird atlas 1974-1979 and the second bird atlas 1986-1989 are important reference materials. The data of the atlas were also used in the evaluation of the Red Listed species in Finland 2010.
dct_title_s: Breeding land-bird line transect censuses in Finland
